theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_te_abs_apply_le_mul_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (η : TestFormOn U n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ c) → Z.mass ≠ ∞ → |Z η| ≤ c * Z.mass.toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
